categories.main_business_segments: China Aluminum International Engineering Corporation Limited (Chalieco) operates primarily in three business segments: design consultancy, EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) project general contracting and construction, and equipment manufacturing. The design consultancy covers mining, ore dressing, smelting, processing, new energy, chemical, and environmental protection industries. EPC business spans metallurgy, housing construction, highways, building materials, electricity, water conservancy, chemical industry, mining, municipal utilities, steel structure, and new energy. Equipment manufacturing focuses on customized metallurgical and processing equipment, environmental protection equipment, mechanical and electronic equipment, industrial automation, and mine safety systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes advanced non-ferrous metal technologies including mining exploration, safe and efficient mining, aluminum electrolysis technologies (ranging from 180kA to 600kA cells), ultra-fine droplet horizontal desulfurization, digital intelligent control systems for electrolytic cells, AI-based optical inspection systems, and smart factory technologies based on 5G industrial internet. It also develops integrated digital platforms for design, delivery, and operation, and advanced equipment for aluminum and copper processing. The company applies digital intelligence, AI, and big data analytics to enhance production efficiency and environmental sustainability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Chalieco serves non-ferrous metal mining, smelting, and processing enterprises, construction enterprises in various industries, and strategic emerging industries such as photovoltaics, new energy vehicles, and power batteries. Major customers include large state-owned enterprises like Chalco, China Copper, and international clients such as Vinacomin Group, Inalum, PT Antam Tbk, and Rio Tinto. The company also serves infrastructure, municipal, and public utilities sectors domestically and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, covering more than 30 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions. Internationally, it has a significant presence in Southeast Asia, Africa, South America, Russian-speaking regions, and Central and Eastern Europe, with projects and offices in countries including Indonesia, Guinea, Turkey, Italy, Laos, Democratic Republic of Congo, and Malaysia. It has established overseas business bases and participates in global mining and metallurgical forums.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chalieco operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the non-ferrous metals supply chain, providing integrated engineering design, construction, and equipment manufacturing services. It covers the entire industrial chain from resource exploration, mining, ore dressing, smelting, processing, to equipment supply and project lifecycle management, including operation and maintenance services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on 'Technology + Internationalization,' emphasizing scientific and technological innovation, digital intelligence, and green low-carbon development. It prioritizes R&D in core technologies across mining, smelting, processing, and equipment manufacturing, with initiatives in AI applications, digital platforms, energy-saving technologies, and environmental protection. The company promotes transformation into a technology service enterprise with integrated 'technology + N' business models, focusing on breakthroughs in green metallurgy, recycling, and digital intelligent solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Chalieco generates revenue primarily through fees from design consultancy services, EPC project general contracting and construction contracts, and sales of customized equipment. Revenue recognition is based on contract progress for construction and equipment manufacturing, and on service completion or progress for design consultancy. The company also explores long-term revenue sharing models linked to technology, services, equipment, and digital maintenance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Chalieco is positioned as a leading technology service enterprise and a major player in non-ferrous industrial technology and engineering construction in China. It ranks among the top global design and contracting firms, appearing in ENR’s Top 150 Global Design Firms and Top 250 Global Contractors. Its competitors include other large engineering and construction firms in the non-ferrous metals and infrastructure sectors, but Chalieco leverages its comprehensive industrial chain advantages, technological leadership, and international presence to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Chalieco reported operating revenue of RMB 24.003 billion, a 7.46% increase year-on-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 221 million, marking a turnaround from previous losses. Overseas revenue grew by 22.5% to RMB 4.133 billion, and newly signed overseas contracts increased by 65.09% to RMB 6.095 billion. The company’s total assets were RMB 41.157 billion with a gearing ratio of 42.82%. It has a large workforce with over 5,700 technical personnel and invests significantly in R&D (RMB 961 million in 2024).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chalieco emphasizes its unique value proposition as a world-class technology service enterprise providing comprehensive solutions for advanced non-ferrous metal technologies, complete sets of equipment, and integrated services. It differentiates itself through its 'triple full' advantages covering all metal categories, the entire industrial chain, and full project lifecycle services. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, technological leadership, extensive qualifications, and integrated business model enable it to deliver high-quality, cost-effective, and innovative solutions that support green, intelligent, and sustainable development in the non-ferrous metals industry.
